rows.finding: Owner cash donations are taxable. Reconciliation effect is not event current tax. Gross license DTA is not a realized credit. Spun-off losses cannot offset VinFast indiscriminately.
Common-control disposal difference is equity under US GAAP. It cannot replace the VAS gain or prove VAS parent/NCI P&L attribution. License offset and cash settlement are distinct.

DPS2 is a fair-value financial liability bundle. Other DPS are equity/NCI with differing conditional dividend rights. October 1, 2025 changes affect conversion/exchange terms; closing ownership and coupon rates do not establish event profit rights.

Tax allocation clauses overlap: licensor bears taxes on payments, while licensee also bears stated withholding/VAT and other taxes above the net fee. Contract terms do not identify actual income-tax expense or paid tax. Some terms are redacted.

Fixed whole-duration fee; actual performance does not reprice it. Replaces Schedule 2 from original effective date. Forecast basis is not a recurring annual royalty; payment deadline remains redacted.
